clips.title: The story
paras: At Coldridge Pass, Mountaineer Thalos warns travelers of troggs in the tunnel. He guards the route from Coldridge Valley toward Kharanos and guides couriers carrying urgent reports.

At the mouth of Coldridge Pass, Mountaineer Thalos guards the route out of Coldridge Valley. Troggs have burrowed up from below and overrun the tunnel, making the crossing dangerous. Thalos warns travelers who are not ready to turn back and judges whether couriers can brave the passage toward the wider kingdom.

After Grelin Whitebeard reports Frostmane troll movements in the secluded valley, a courier carries the report to Grelin's brother Senir in Kharanos. Before entering the tunnel, the courier is told to speak with Mountaineer Thalos. He sends capable travelers onward through the pass to Kharanos, where regional commanders coordinate Dun Morogh's defense. The route carries vital intelligence toward Ironforge's military leaders.
